up: Retrieve IC50 bioactivity data in nM for compound CHEMBL1173655 and all its related salts/parent forms against target CHEMBL203. Resolve the compound set by using molecule_hierarchy: first find the parent_molregno of CHEMBL1173655, then select all molregno values that share this parent_molregno (including the parent itself and all child salts). Filter activities where standard_type = 'IC50' and standard_units = 'nM'. Filter assays by joining target_dictionary where chembl_id = 'CHEMBL203'. Return exactly these columns: compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary), canonical_smiles (from compound_structures), compound_key (from compound_records), pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer docs.pubmed_id, fallback to docs.doi), assay_description (assays.description), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment (all from activities), target_chembl_id (target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (target_dictionary.pref_name), and target_organism (target_dictionary.organism). Do not limit the number of returned rows. Ensure joins link activities.molregno to molecule_dictionary, activities.record_id to compound_records, activities.assay_id to assays, and assays.tid to target_dictionary.
sql:
WITH target_parent AS (
    SELECT mh.parent_molregno
    FROM molecule_hierarchy mh
    JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON mh.molregno = md.molregno
    WHERE md.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1173655'
),
related_compounds AS (
    SELECT mh.molregno
    FROM molecule_hierarchy mh
    JOIN target_parent tp ON mh.parent_molregno = tp.parent_molregno
)
SELECT
    md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    cr.compound_key,
    COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
    asy.description AS assay_description,
    a.standard_type,
    a.standard_relation,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_units,
    a.activity_comment,
    td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
    td.pref_name AS target_name,
    td.organism AS target_organism
FROM related_compounds rc
JOIN activities a ON a.molregno = rc.molregno
JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON asy.tid = td.tid
LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL203'
